description: Implementation of PaymentService interface for handling payment processing, configurations, and validations in a Spring-based e-commerce system.

classes.name: PaymentServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing payment processing, configuration management, and validation logic for an online store.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves payment modules available for a specific merchant store based on region.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Lists accepted payment methods for a store, including configuration details and types.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Finds a payment method module based on its type (e.g., CREDITCARD, PAYPAL).

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module by its unique code.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the configuration for a specific payment module for a store.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Loads all configured payment modules for a store.

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and saves a payment module's configuration for a store.

methods.name: removePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a payment module configuration from a store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Handles payment authorization, capture, and transaction creation based on customer, store, payment data, and order details.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Returns a payment module implementation by its code.

methods.name: processCapturePayment
methods.description: Completes a capture transaction for an order that was authorized previously.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a given order and amount.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Validates credit card details including number, expiration date, and performs Luhn check.
